review_notes: Fourteen packed candidate frames: nine viable original paintings plus two alternating foot lifts, two-handed butt-strike windup/contact and clean shouldered firing recoil.

Original close contact lost its support hand and read as aiming. New pair reverses the whole weapon for a physical stock-first attack; both hands remain attached at the same stock-neck/barrel grips, with three crystals and one seal tag retained.

Original firing paint includes colored checkerboard around its projectile; that whole pose is excluded. New recoil contains no projectile/flash, keeping existing combat VFX separate. Actual shot-event timing remains pending gameplay acceptance.
Movement is a short-step cycle with planted idle transitions and alternating foot lifts. The attempted opposite-contact draft repeats lead and stays unselected, not counted as a full-stride phase.

Connected neutral preparation retains ivory paint; explicit crops exclude neighboring muzzle/flash/boot/coat fragments while retaining the complete dropped projector and persistent dark-muzzled corpse.

Final atlas inspected as production evidence only. Fine hair/string/cloth edges, face/weapon/body scale, hand support, connected gait, hit/death cloth continuity and actual event timing require full-roster refinement and consolidated acceptance.
No tests/imports/exports or paid API, gameplay/save/footprint changes. Full160 production and consolidated Linux/Windows acceptance remain open.
